score.scope: Exact normalized values within each completely annotated selected input passage. Instances match on values and sorted unique passage IDs, independently of quote offsets. Claim IDs are ignored; semantic duplicates within a passage collapse and are counted. Grounding additionally requires the entire independently reviewed supporting span. These exposed development scores are not held-out or broad-corpus quality.

Exposed, completely annotated in-catalogue spans only. Match values and unique passage IDs, with frozen timing alternatives; ignore arbitrary claim/episode IDs. Romantic pairs are symmetric; parent/guardian roles are directed. Distinct episode instances retain multiplicity; duplicates within the same episode collapse. One-to-one value matching ignores ID spelling. Ambiguous alignments maximize episode agreement, then ordering; over 4096 alternatives leaves those two scores unavailable. Raw duplicates and full-reference-span grounding are separate. Missing episode pairs fail. This conservative grounding proxy is not independent semantic/canon adjudication.
